product_overview: SecureVault is a single-page web app for storing, organizing, and unlocking sensitive vault items such as documents, photos, passwords, and secrets. Users can sign in, set up their profile and security PIN, manage stored items, and decrypt protected content when needed.
core_goals: Create a vault account and sign in to the app
Complete first-time profile and security PIN setup
Browse, search, and filter stored vault items
Add documents or credentials to the vault
Unlock protected items with a security PIN and view sensitive details

features.name: User Authentication
features.description: Users can access SecureVault by signing in with email and password, creating a new vault account, or using the demo vault credentials.
user_flows: Navigate to / -> Open the vault access flow -> Switch to the create account view -> Enter email -> Enter password -> Submit the form -> See the next onboarding step
Navigate to / -> Open the vault access flow -> Switch to the sign in view -> Enter email -> Enter password -> Submit the form -> Enter the vault
Navigate to / -> Open the vault access flow -> Choose the demo vault option -> Enter the app with pre-seeded vault data
Navigate to / -> Open the vault access flow -> Switch to the sign in view -> Enter invalid credentials -> Submit the form -> See an error alert

features.name: First-Time Profile Setup
features.description: New or incomplete accounts can complete an onboarding step to save full name, optional phone number, and an avatar photo.
user_flows: Navigate to / -> Access the profile setup flow after authentication -> Enter full name -> Enter optional phone number -> Upload an avatar photo from the local device -> Review the profile details -> Continue to save the profile -> See the account proceed to the next setup step

features.name: 4-Digit Security PIN Setup
features.description: Users can establish a required four-digit security PIN for protecting vault access and sensitive item decryption.
user_flows: Navigate to / -> Access the PIN setup flow after authentication -> Enter a 4-digit PIN -> Re-enter the same 4-digit PIN -> Complete PIN setup -> See the unlock success animation
Navigate to / -> Access the PIN setup flow after authentication -> Enter a 4-digit PIN -> Re-enter a different 4-digit PIN -> Attempt to continue -> See a PIN mismatch error

features.name: Vault Item Categories & Search
features.description: Users can browse vault contents, switch between item categories, and search for stored items in real time.
user_flows: Navigate to / -> Access the vault dashboard -> Select the All category -> View the full list of items and their status details
Navigate to / -> Access the vault dashboard -> Select a specific category such as Documents, Photos, Passwords, or Secrets -> View only matching items
Navigate to / -> Access the vault dashboard -> Type a search term -> See the item list update in real time to matching results
Navigate to / -> Access the vault dashboard -> Type a search term with no matches -> See an empty result state

features.name: Add Item with Celebration Popup
features.description: Users can add a new document or password to the vault and receive a celebratory success confirmation after saving.
user_flows: Navigate to / -> Open the add item flow -> Choose the document option -> Upload or drag in a file -> Save the item to the vault -> See a celebratory success popup -> Choose to return to the vault

Navigate to / -> Open the add item flow -> Choose the password option -> Generate or enter a secure password -> Save the credential to the vault -> See a celebratory success popup -> Choose to add another item

features.name: PIN Verification & Decryption
features.description: Users can unlock locked vault items by entering their security PIN and then view decrypted sensitive details.
user_flows: Navigate to / -> Access the vault dashboard -> Select a locked item card -> Enter the 4-digit security PIN -> See the decrypted item details -> Copy the revealed credential to the clipboard
Navigate to / -> Access the vault dashboard -> Select a locked item card -> Enter an incorrect 4-digit security PIN five times -> Attempt another unlock -> See a temporary 30-second lockout message
